_readme: Copy to <project>/.claude/one-go/config.json. Every extra below is OFF as shipped. Turn on only what your project has; a key you delete is the same as off. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_claims_file: A table where several chat windows note which files they are holding, e.g. ".claude/ACTIVE-WORK.md". null = off.
_frozen_dirs: Folders of approved designs that need a yes before they change, e.g. ["docs/frozen"]. check-plan warns when a pass writes there.
_screen_gate: "on" refuses to start a job named like a screen (see screen_slug_pattern) until its design folder is marked frozen. Leave "off" unless you use frozen_dirs.
_extra_sources: Extra lists the board reads: pending_push = a file listing commits waiting for a push, e.g. ".claude/PENDING-PUSH.md".
_worklog: A file that gets one line per finished run, e.g. ".claude/WORKLOG.md". null = off.
_register_command: A command your project uses to approve a new file path before it is written. null = off.
_worker_always_allowed: Paths every helper may write besides its own files, e.g. ["notes/**"].
_report_extras: Extra lines for the end-of-run report. when = committed or open_items; {commits} and {run_dir} are filled in.

report_extras.text: Commits waiting for a push: {commits}. Nothing was pushed.

_default_host: The tool passes run in when start does not say: claude, codex, antigravity, opencode or inline. null = claude.
_parallel_limit: How many passes may run at once. null = as many as the waves allow, up to 8. Or a whole number 1 to 16. --parallel N on start wins over it.
_hosts: Model ids only as each tool lists them (reference/HOSTS.md). A <placeholder> names no model, so the helper inherits the main model. Or use "auto" to let the scout pick from the model cards. Claude Code needs no entry.

codex.think: <model slug from the Codex models list>

_model_cards: Path to a model card file, e.g. ".claude/one-go/model-cards.json". Needed only when a host above uses "auto". null = no cards, the scout never runs.
_model_scout: Settings for the scout: max_age_days (ask to refresh cards older than this), preference (quality, quality-where-it-counts, cost), opencode_providers (which OpenCode providers to consider; add the ones you have signed in to).
